title: malaxis rotundata
intro: Malaxis rotundata, commonly known as the Round-leaf Malaxis or Chinese Malaxis, is a species of orchid that belongs to the genus Malaxis. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to treat various health conditions such as fever, cough, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis rotundata include anti-bacterial, anti-viral, and anti-fungal properties, which can help to prevent and treat infections. The bioactive constituents of Malaxis rotundata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
